def replace(self, **parts):
        """Return a new version with the specified components replaced.

        Unspecified components are preserved. Pass ``None`` to remove the
        prerelease or build component. The original version is unchanged.

        >>> VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'rc.1', 'build.2').replace(major=2, build=None)
        VersionInfo(major=2, minor=2, patch=3, prerelease='rc.1', build=None)
        """
        version = self._asdict()
        unknown = set(parts).difference(version)
        if unknown:
            raise TypeError(
                "replace() got %d unexpected keyword argument(s): %s" %
                (len(unknown), ', '.join(sorted(unknown))))
        version.update(parts)
        return type(self)(**version)
